definitions.high: Training tickets labeled `high` priority are, by relative word frequency against the other two priority values (words appearing in at least 20 `high`-priority tickets), most distinguished by: severe, timeouts, major, reverting, rolling, overloads, outage, reliability, interruption, ceased, interrupted, capacity.
definitions.low: Training tickets labeled `low` priority are, by relative word frequency against the other two priority values (words appearing in at least 20 `low`-priority tickets), most distinguished by: com, lack, providers, browser, feature, low, commitments, finds, utmost, value, long, delay.
definitions.medium: Training tickets labeled `medium` priority are, by relative word frequency against the other two priority values (words appearing in at least 20 `medium`-priority tickets), most distinguished by: demonstrate, scope, app, organizations, modifying, knowing, transaction, lately, compatible, month, predictions, conflicting.
